title: Newton: saucer settled gently within 500 miles of Denver

tellings.quote: Within 500 m of the city of Denver, there settled gently to Earth a round object which had already been identified as being a flying saucer.

plain: Sometime around 1948 to 1950, a round flying saucer came down gently, without crashing, somewhere within 500 miles of Denver, according to a man named Silas Newton, heard on the show in his own words. Newton says that there "settled gently to Earth a round object which had already been identified as being a flying saucer." If true, it would mean an intact craft was recovered in the American West.
